text:
Asha R.: hi — rode Uber from SFO to hotel yesterday and the app failed to send a receipt. trip shows in app but when I try to email receipt it errors out. card shows $34.20. can i still expense this? i attached a screenshot of the bank txn.
Ben (People Ops): sorry about the hassle. first try: in the app go to Your Trips > select trip > Request receipt. if that fails, request an invoice from the provider website (ridehistory). upload any screenshots + the bank txn + a short attestation. if provider can't provide a receipt then we accept manager signoff + a lost-receipt attestation (see template). use expense code TRV-LOST-REC.
Tom (Travel Operations): @Asha R. quick Q — was this booked via personal card? if company card we can usually reconcile via bank txn for <$50. since you used personal, we'll need either the provider invoice or manager approval + attestation. can you DM me the trip date/time and driver name so we can try to pull logs?
people-ops-bot: Expense request A-4023 created for Asha R. — please upload supporting docs to Concur under "Lost receipt (ride)". For urgent payroll reimbursement reply with "pay-me-now".
Asha R.: thanks — DM sent to Tom with screenshot of the app trip page and the bank transaction. i also requested invoice via the web form just now.
Maya (Manager): confirming — this was an on-site client visit on 2025-03-14 for the Redwood demo. i approve reimbursement if docs are missing.
Ben (People Ops): got it. with manager confirmation we can approve up to $75 for a single ride without a provider invoice. AP will process once you upload the attestation: "I, Asha R., attest that the expense of $34.20 on 2025-03-14 was a business ride to a client site. Provider invoice unavailable despite retrieval attempts." then mark expense type TRV-LOST-REC.
Tom (Travel Operations): FYI for ops: when driver name + pickup/drop + bank txn match we mark as validated. if provider later supplies invoice we'll attach and close.
Asha R.: uploaded attestation and manager approval screenshot. thanks all!
Ben (People Ops): :thumbsup: forwarding to AP. small reminder to the team — enable email receipts in ride apps and add company email as backup.
